oil.when: 2009–2017 (first generation) with the vehicle information and set/reset buttons for the Driver Information Center
steps: Reset only after the engine oil and filter have actually been changed.
Turn the ignition to ON/RUN but leave the engine off.
Press the vehicle information button until OIL LIFE REMAINING shows on the display.
Press and hold the set/reset button until the display reads 100%. Three chimes sound and the CHANGE ENGINE OIL SOON message goes off.
oil.note: Checked in the 2009 Getting to Know Your Enclave guide and the 2017 owner's manual.

steps: Set all four tires to the cold pressure on the tire label on the driver's door pillar.
There is no reset button. The low tire pressure light stays on until the pressures are corrected.
Once the tires are filled correctly, drive the vehicle and the light goes off.
A tire pressure message on the display can be cleared for now with the display buttons, but it comes back at the next start if a tire is still low.
tpms.note: Checked in the 2009 and 2011 Getting to Know Your Enclave guides. If the light flashes for about a minute and then stays on, the system has a fault that adding air will not fix.

notes: Even if the oil life system has not asked for a change, change the oil and filter at least once a year.
